note: Runtime, tools, tests and CI. Regenerate with npm run docs:generate; validate with npm run lint:docs.

files.description: Maintained config: .github/workflows/ci.yml.
Manifest V3 declaration: permissions, host permissions, service worker, popup, icons.
npm scripts for validation, tests, doc index checks, and packaging. Zero dependencies.
Renders the real popup and viewer markup into screenshot harness pages and generates a genuine PDF, for Chrome Web Store assets.
Path-validates the documentation retrieval indexes; --prune removes dead entries.
Maintained tooling: scripts/check-syntax.mjs.
Composes captured harness renders into the 1280x800 store screenshots and the 440x280 promo tile.
Maintained tooling: scripts/generate-doc-index.mjs.
Draws the extension's icon set — a document mark on the project's red field — at every declared size, with size-aware detail.
Builds the Chrome Web Store archive from only the files Chrome loads.
Validates manifest shape, referenced files, icon PNG signatures and real pixel dimensions, and absence of Manifest V2 keys.
MV3 service worker. Owns all network and tab work; runs the direct-download and transcript-panel strategies; message contract with the popup.
Injected transcript-panel reader. Handles both YouTube markup generations plus a structural fallback. The most fragile file in the repo.
Dependency-free PDF 1.4 writer: toWinAnsi, wrapText, buildTranscriptPdf, toSafeFilename. Helvetica AFM metrics, verified xref table.
Pure caption parsing and formatting: parseJson3, parseTimedTextXml, parseCaptions, formatTimestamp, groupIntoParagraphs, renderText.
Pure YouTube URL parsing and watch-page scraping: parseVideoId, parseWatchPage, pickTrack, extractJsonVar, watchUrl.
Popup styles with light and dark palettes.
Popup markup. Module script only, no inline handlers.
Popup controller: prefill, fetch, preview, PDF download, print handoff, clipboard, persisted options.
Viewer styles including print rules.
Printable viewer markup.
Printable viewer. Reads a one-shot payload from session storage, deletes it, renders for Chrome print-to-PDF.
Behavioral regression tests for content-script.test.js.
Tests: transliteration, word wrap, PDF structural validity including byte-accurate xref offsets, pagination, filenames.
Behavioral regression tests for popup.test.js.
Behavioral regression tests for service-worker.test.js.
Behavioral regression tests for store_assets_test.py.
Behavioral regression tests for tooling.test.js.
Tests: json3 and XML parsing, empty bodies, timestamps, paragraph grouping, render options.
Behavioral regression tests for viewer.test.js.
Tests: URL shapes, hostname allowlist, watch-page parsing, fallbacks, parsed flag, track selection.
